subject.title: feat(browser): extract action — answer page questions via a bounded sub-model call

question: Should OpenClaw expose a first-class `browser extract` action that answers page questions with a bounded model call instead of requiring snapshot text in the primary agent context?
rationale: The implementation is additive and tested, but it creates a new public tool and CLI behavior with an intentional model-call and page-content-processing product contract.

options.title: Sponsor the extract action
options.body: Accept the bounded model-backed read path as a supported Browser plugin capability, subject to the normal final CI and owner review.

options.title: Keep snapshots as the only read path
options.body: Decline the new action if the additional public model-call behavior and maintenance surface are not desired.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the extract action
recommendation.body: Accept the bounded model-backed read path as a supported Browser plugin capability, subject to the normal final CI and owner review.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR’s author owns the proposed feature shape and can incorporate any chosen Browser-plugin direction.
